business_problem: Accenture needed a people and HR platform that could support rapid operating-model change, skills visibility, hiring speed, and personalized employee experiences for a workforce of more than 780,000 people.
solution_summary: Accenture and Workday built a connected people-data platform that underpins internal HR, skills, recruiting, and workforce planning with real-time data and AI. Workday became the central system where Accenture chose to keep all people data, replacing siloed talent acquisition and learning environments with a more standardized global model. The platform is integrated across HR, finance, sales, skills, staffing, payroll, and revenue so leaders can see adjacent skills, industry specializations, locations, and business demand in one place. On top of that data foundation, Accenture uses predictive modeling to forecast talent needs and has launched gen-AI-enabled performance management tools plus other skills-focused experiences. Salesforce and Workday are also linked so sales-pipeline signals can inform talent decisions in real time. The result is not just an HR system of record, but an operational workforce intelligence platform that helps Accenture reorganize faster, hire faster, and align people decisions with business growth.
